_notes: Rows on dev staging that no code in this repo can remove, with the evidence for each.

The residue sweep skips them instead of burning a DELETE per row per run — six failed deletes cost ~10s and buried the real 409s in warn noise for weeks (run 35589360814 reported candidates 3 / deleted 0 and nobody noticed).

They are inert: every identifier the suite mints is run- and attempt-unique, so a stranded row can never collide with a future run. Burn-down list, not a permanent excuse — delete an entry the moment the API can clear it.
A row whose blocker is a TRANSFERRED time card does not need an entry: the reconcile detects those at runtime and hands the ids to the sweep.
